blocks.text: The Philippines is on a mission to claim its second victories in three international pageants taking place in neighboring Southeast Asian countries — the Miss and Mister Global competitions and the Universal Woman contest. Jayvee Lyn Lorejo will try to score the Philippines’ second win at the Miss Global pageant in Thailand, while her fellow ALV Pageant Circle queen Marizza Delgado plans to become the second Filipino woman to win the Universal Woman title in Cambodia. International pageant veteran MJ Ordillano also flew to Thailand to join Lorejo, and try to post the Philippines’ second victory at the Mister Global pageant, […]...
